text:
Which statements about ethene are correct?
1
It contains a C=C bond.
2
It does not decolourise bromine water.
3
Its molecules can join together to form long chain compounds.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry

content.html: It contains a C=C bond. It does not decolourise bromine water. Its molecules can join together to form long chain compounds.
